scope: Exploratory scalar bug-repair tasks. Public fixtures, held out from each agent workspace; not secret or contamination-resistant. Broader repository/API/ownership/stateful/performance tasks remain required before an adoption decision.

tasks.requirement: Repair is_fresh(now, deadline): a cached value is fresh precisely when now is strictly before deadline. Int arguments are signed 64-bit timestamps. Preserve the function interface.
Repair clamp(value, low, high): return low below low, high above high, and value otherwise. Callers guarantee low <= high. Int arguments are signed 64-bit integers. Preserve the function interface.
Repair sum_to(n): return the sum of all integers from 0 through n inclusive. Callers guarantee 0 <= n <= 10000. Preserve the function interface.
